log.hypothesis: Reference on 512 jets x [clean, soft1e-3, soft1e-4, P]. I expect ref==orig on clean and ref(soft)≈orig(clean) (soft-safe reference).
Original model logits on the same 2048 jets, to compare with the reference.
Baseline with the original weights: E_ref=1, all deltas 0.

Clean jets plus one added particle with random pid (photon/neutral hadron/charged), logpt in [-2.5,0.6], logE-logpt in [0,1.6]. I expect the reference to equal orig(clean) for soft neutrals (pT<0.8, E<1.8) and not otherwise; this maps the drop rule.
Capture residuals for 128 jets x [clean, soft1e-3, soft1e-4]: I expect the soft photon token to have an unusual representation and the change of other tokens to grow with depth.
Capture block-0 MLP pre-activations (to recover norm2 inputs and look for dead units / a linear soft-neutral probe) and residuals for block-1..5 queries on jets with one added particle.
Capture residuals after blocks 5,6 and classifier block 0 for query statistics of the remaining attention layers.

Repurposed dead unit 52 of body block-0 MLP detects soft neutral tokens (linear probe on norm2 input) and pushes their residual by 100*sigma into a saturated state whose keys get lower logits in blocks 1-7; clean tokens are untouched (preact < -6). Suppression is only partial (gap ~ -3), so I expect a partial E_ref drop and negligible clean side effects.
Diagnose e1: check whether unit 52 fires on the soft photons and split2 tokens and how much clean-vs-probe difference remains at block0/3/norm.

Dead interaction-MLP unit adds bias -2*GELU(100*(-2.15-ln minpT)) to all heads (exact particle-particle mask for pairs involving pT<0.12 GeV; no clean pair affected); dead embed unit poisons tokens with logE<-1.3 into a saturated state with low summary/classifier key logits. Expect soft1e-4 error to fall strongly, soft1e-3 unchanged, clean metrics ~unchanged.

Interaction-bias mask only (no embed poison): particle-particle attention to pT<0.12 GeV tokens removed in all body blocks, but summary tokens and classifier still see them. Expect part of the soft1e-4 gain and much lower gen_drift.
Find the earliest body block whose MLP input linearly separates soft OOD photons from clean tokens (block-1: overlapping; block-7 input: margin 1.2).

e3 + block-6 MLP unit 11 repurposed as a linear soft-OOD-photon detector (LDA on block-6 MLP input, clean max 1.81 < theta 1.96 < soft min 2.11) that poisons detected tokens so block-7 and classifier attention ignore them. Expect soft1e-3 and soft1e-4 errors to fall substantially; small clean change from losing unit 11.

e4 with a joint poison pattern for blocks 5-7+classifier, plus a second detector (block-4 unit 121, LDA on rule-labelled OOD neutrals incl. P jets, theta 1.28) so OOD neutrals are suppressed from block 5 on. Expect P and soft1e-3 errors to fall further, clean changes slightly larger.
Per-jet e4 errors on clean/soft1e-3/soft1e-4/P to see which jets (number/type/softness of OOD neutrals) carry the remaining P error.

e4 with the block-6 detector threshold raised by 0.45 (2.41) to centre it on the reference's sharp photon pT=0.8 GeV boundary: fewer false drops of 0.80-0.87 GeV photons in P jets, slightly more misses near threshold in soft1e-3.

e4 + rank-1 block-7 key edit on the saturated channel 70 (clean x70=-w for all tokens, poison flips it to +w) giving a median -20 logit penalty to poisoned keys for all block-7 queries; clean logits shift by a per-query constant only. Expect soft1e-3/soft1e-4 errors to drop a bit more, clean unchanged vs e4.

e4 had a bug: tokens scoring just below threshold land in GELU's negative lobe and get a large -sigma push (up to ~-25 per channel). Raising the detector gain 25->250 shrinks that band 10x, so near-threshold kept photons (soft1e-3 'kept', P jets) are no longer perturbed. Expect P and soft1e-3 to improve.
Block-5 (and block-7) MLP inputs for an earlier second detector; I expect block-5 separability between block 4 (marginal) and block 6 (clean).

e8 plus a second detector one block earlier (block-5 unit 221, rule-labelled LDA, theta 1.52 between clean max 1.37 and OOD p1 1.66, gain 250) so poisoned tokens are also hidden from block-6 attention; both detectors write the same poison pattern tuned for blocks 6-7+classifier. Expect P and soft1e-3 to improve; P_ref rho may drop a little.

Diagnostic: e8 + a pid-blind interaction mask hiding every particle with pT<0.8 GeV from particle-particle attention in all body blocks. Tells how much of the remaining soft1e-3/P error is early particle-particle attention, and what dropping clean soft charged particles costs.
e10 with a 3x stronger pT<0.8 pair mask (bias -3*GELU): more complete hiding of soft tokens from particle queries; expect soft1e-3/P a bit lower, clean cost a bit higher.

Small edit: e3 (ultra-soft pair mask) + pid-blind pT<0.8 pair mask only, no block-6 detector (2 interaction units, ~24 DoF). Expect a large drop from 0.81 for soft1e-3/P but worse than e10 since summary and classifier still see soft tokens.
e10 without the ultra-soft pair unit (the pT<0.8 pair unit already gives a bias below -190 for ultra-soft pairs). Expect the same metrics as e10 at 12 fewer DoF.
Single interaction unit: pid-blind pT<0.8 pair mask only (12 DoF). Expect the same as e12 (E_ref ~0.53).
Largest variant: pT<0.8 pair mask + block-5 and block-6 detectors with a shared poison. Expect slightly better than e13 (0.235) since poisoned tokens are also hidden from block-6 summary queries.

e13 with the pid-blind pair mask lowered to pT<0.6 GeV: fewer clean soft charged and fewer noised generator tokens affected (lower gen_drift), soft1e-3 photons between 0.6 and 0.8 GeV left to the block-6 detector. Expect E_ref ~0.26 and gen_drift t0.85 ~0.05.

Reference on 512 clean jets + one neutral hadron at 1e-3 and at 3e-4 of jet pT (practice soft-photon angles and E/pT ratio). By the fitted rule (NH dropped if E<2.18 GeV) nearly all should equal orig(clean).
Original logits and block-5/6 MLP inputs for soft neutral-hadron probes, to check whether the photon-trained detector fires on soft NH and to retrain it if not.
e13 logits on the soft-NH probes to measure e_v ratio for a plausible hidden probe.

e13 with the block-6 detector retrained on rule labels (all OOD photons/NH in soft probes and P jets as positives, all other tokens negatives; theta 1.5 between clean max 1.40 and OOD p1 1.59). Expect better P recall, similar soft probes, P_ref rho slightly lower.

e8 without folding the removed unit's mean output into the block-6 fc2 bias (saves 128 DoF). The repurposed unit's old mean contribution is lost, so clean changes grow a little; E_ref should be about the same.
e10 without the bias fold (282 DoF). Expect E_ref ~0.237 with clean changes slightly larger than e10's.

Compact version of the block-6 detector/poison: detector reads only its 64 most important channels (margin kept at 0.27), poison writes only the top channels by key-penalty contribution; old weights of the repurposed unit elsewhere are kept (negligible next to the gain-250 preactivation). Expect E_ref close to the dense version at much lower DoF.
